entities.summary: Julia Schwarzbach is a German weightlifter. She competed at the 2008 Summer Olympics in the women's 53 kg, finishing 7th with a total of 185 kg. In the same event at the 2012 Summer Olympics, she finished 11th, with a total of 193 kg.
